name: How does your design-build process work for a major home renovation or addition?

mainEntity.name: How does your design-build process work for a major home renovation or addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our integrated design-build process ensures a single point of coordination for your entire project, from concept to completion. It begins with an in-depth consultation to understand your vision and needs, followed by comprehensive design planning with CAD-supported layouts. Once designs are approved, we handle all aspects of construction, permit coordination, material selection, and installation, maintaining clear communication throughout. This managed process minimizes complexities and ensures design vision translates directly into construction execution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our design-build process unifies design planning and construction under one team, managing everything from consultation and CAD layouts to permits and final walkthrough.
